prompt: Agrega un campo `website` (string, opcional) a la entidad supplier. Debe aparecer en el response DTO y en Swagger.

assertions.name: Reads existing files before proposing changes
assertions.description: The response explicitly reads or lists the existing supplier files before proposing changes

assertions.name: Identifies all affected layers
assertions.description: Identifies domain entity, mapper, response DTO, and DB entity as affected

assertions.name: Applies changes domain first
assertions.description: Domain entity change is proposed before application layer changes

assertions.name: Migration required is called out
assertions.description: Explicitly states that a migration is required
